desc: Test the current code with the three sample inputs to see if it matches the expected outputs.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N = 2*max(W,H) + 10 modulo 998244353.
Implement a function C(n,k) to compute binomial coefficients modulo 998244353.
Derive and implement the correct closed-form formula for the number of valid paths, using the inclusion-exclusion over the four corridors (bottom, top, left, right) and their intersections.
If the formula is incorrect, derive the correct formula by considering the "transfer matrix" method or by carefully analyzing the "detour" paths around the hole.
Optimize the solution to handle large inputs (W,H up to 1e6) efficiently (O(1) or O(log) time after precomputation).
Write the final code in Python, ensuring it reads from stdin and writes to stdout.
